_comment: Platform methods whose whole body calls another public method of the same object with the same arguments. Replacing the second with the first leaves every call a runtime checker observes as it was (App Manager generateRSAKeyPair, 2026-11-01). Only add an entry with a citation of the delegating body in OpenJDK and Android libcore; an SPI default that a provider may override (KeyStore.setEntry -> engineSetEntry) is not an alias.

aliases.source: OpenJDK and Android libcore java/security/KeyPairGenerator.java: public final KeyPair genKeyPair() { return generateKeyPair(); }

required_parameter_specs.source: Android Keystore AndroidKeyStoreAuthenticatedAESCipherSpi.GCM rejects any AlgorithmParameterSpec but GCMParameterSpec ("Only GCMParameterSpec supported"); JDK/Conscrypt GCM ciphers take the tag length only from GCMParameterSpec.

empty_store_types._comment: Store types that hold nothing after load(null): file-format stores, whose content comes only from the stream they load or the entries set on them. A provider-backed store (AndroidCAStore, AndroidKeyStore) is filled by the platform on load(null) and is never listed here (Cryptomator Lite tryToFindDefaultTrustManager, 2026-11-04 measurement). KeyStore.getDefaultType() is a file format on Android (BKS/PKCS12) and on the JDK (PKCS12 since 9).
empty_store_types.source: Java Security Standard Algorithm Names, KeyStore Types; Android KeyStore docs (AndroidKeyStore / AndroidCAStore are system-backed)
